title: Introduce invocation-census, log-fidelity ladder, and alert-sculptor for noise-reduced token observability
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adds a lightweight invocation census sampler, a tiered log-fidelity ladder to reduce high-volume log noise, and an alert-sculptor to automatically tune alert sensitivity using silhouette-based quieting. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: Our alert noise and log egress costs are driven by long-tail invocations that produce noisy stacks and high token-level telemetry. This PR introduces three coordinated ideas: 1) an invocation-census sampler that produces compact per-invocation summaries and stratified estimates of token distribution; 2) a log-fidelity ladder: tiered log capture (minimal -> trace -> full) escalated deterministically by census signals and cost heuristics; and 3) alert-sculptor: a stabilization layer that uses silhouette-like cohesion scoring across invocation cohorts to auto-suppress spurious alert bursts while preserving SLO signal.

Summary of changes: Implemented a streaming census sampler that maintains lightweight histograms (shape, token count, kernel class) and emits per-invocation compact digests. Added a laddered logging controller that subscribes to census digests and promotes/demotes log fidelity via a short-lived policy token; integrated with existing log-sidecar to reduce payloads for low-value invocations. Built an alert-sculptor service that consumes census rollups and alerts, computes cohort silhouette scores to identify noisy cohorts, and applies scoped alert-squelch windows.

Design notes: The census sampler is intentionally low-cardinality: it records categorical features (model_family, route, quantization_profile, kernel_tag) plus numeric sketches (token_count_bucket, response_latency_bucket). No raw prompt text is retained. The log-fidelity ladder enforces privacy rules (no PII promotion) and emits a fidelity audit event when promoting an invocation. The alert-sculptor operates with conservative default thresholds and a three-stage approval: observe -> suggest -> apply (with auto-revert).

Rollout plan: Canary on the obs-staging cluster (two zones) for 72h, synthetic replay against golden traffic, enable automatic demotion only after 24h stable metrics. If the sculptor suppresses >20% of alerts for any team in a 1h window, it will auto-open a ticket and revert to observe mode.

Testing: Unit tests for sampler codecs, integration tests for ladder policy interaction with the log-sidecar, and an end-to-end replay bench to validate that overall log egress reduces by ~55% on sampled workloads while per-route SLO alert recall stays within 2% of baseline.

Migration: No DB migrations. Observability indices (census-rollup) are a new target stream; dashboards added but optional. Operators can disable the ladder policy via feature flags.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of census sampler and on-disk codec
- [x] Ladder controller + log-sidecar integration
- [x] Alert-sculptor service and policy engine
- [x] Dashboards and runbook entries
- [x] Canary + replay tests

Related: Informs ENG-3421 (alert noise reduction initiative), followup will add tenant-aware sculpting and RBAC controls.
